text: I am taking care of the stables.

Usually, I take care of the horses as well.
But the stables are empty, as you can see.
zh:
平时我也负责照料马匹。
但你也看到了，马厩现在空空如也。

text: You've probably heard about the monsters on the trade route to Erstadt.
zh: 你大概也听说了，通往埃尔施塔特的商路上出了怪物。

text: Obviously, no merchant dares to travel from Erstadt to our capital.
zh: 显然，没有商人敢从埃尔施塔特赶来王都了。

text:
But that shouldn't stop me from doing my job.
The stables don't clean themselves.
zh:
但这不妨碍我做好分内的活儿。
马厩可不会自己打扫自己。
